name: Westports Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Westports Holdings Berhad 的公告主要涉及股息再投资计划（DRP）下的新股发行、股份上市及股息除权安排，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新季度营收同比增长54.6%，净利润同比增长47.9%。
overview_en: In 2026, Westports Holdings Berhad's announcements mainly involved new share issuances under the dividend reinvestment plan (DRP), share listings, and dividend ex-date arrangements. No expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract awards were disclosed for its business segments. Latest quarterly revenue grew 54.6% year-on-year, and net profit grew 47.9% year-on-year.
